If you’re on a Windows machine and want to see the time directly from the Command Prompt, you can run:

```cmd

```

```powershell
Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"   # local time
Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" -UFormat "%s"   # UTC
```
